notes.headline: The champs start as favorites, and K-Ville bought its way into the chase
notes.dek: Week 1 tips off Tuesday, Oct 20. Here's how the 12 rosters stack up on paper, who made the big offseason moves, and what to watch in the opening matchups.
notes.byline: Written from Fantrax projections and this offseason's transactions.

storylines.title: Guangdong is still the team to beat
storylines.body: The defending champs project first in points and rebounds and second in 3s and assists. On paper they beat all 11 teams in a weekly matchup. Their weak spot is turnovers, where they project last.

storylines.title: K-Ville went all in
storylines.body: K-Ville sent six players, a 2027 1st and two 2026 1sts to Next UP: Zach Babies for Kevin Durant, James Harden, Kawhi Leonard, Dillon Brooks and Grayson Allen. They now project first in 3s, FT% and assists.

storylines.title: Zach Babies are playing the long game
storylines.body: Last year's 10–7 team now holds five 2027 1sts and projects last in five categories. Expect their veterans to be available to anyone chasing a title.

storylines.title: Team OD wants the one that got away
storylines.body: OD went 15–2 last regular season and lost the final. They project second overall and first in steals.

storylines.title: The big-man builds
storylines.body: Competing God and Blocktopus Prime project top two in both FG% and blocks and near the bottom in 3s and assists. They'll win the paint and give away the perimeter most weeks.

matchups.070oazg4mqqv88in_b33iacngmqqv88in: Opening-week headliner: the champs against the league's best shot-blocking team. Guangdong projects to take it 5–4, but both percentage categories are within a few points, so either one could flip it.
matchups.mizl2op8mqqv88im_cipchrpimqqv88in: Also projected 5–4. Shanghai's edge in FG% and rebounds against OD's steals and FT% could tip either way.
matchups.ctvglb6gmqqv88in_xoe774vlmqqv88in: K-Ville's new veterans debut against eweiss35. K-Ville projects a comfortable 7–2.
matchups.ygisq4rlmqqv88in_rufupenmmqqv88in: LeBrown James projects 6–3 on the strength of 3s and FT%. Competing God needs a big FG% and rebounding week.
matchups.n3z2eshxmqqv88in_saydaqzgmqqv88in: West Palm Salon projects 7–2 against a Zach Babies roster built for 2027.
matchups.auysoygrmqqv88in_d91prsm4mqqv88in: A matchup of two rebuilding teams. Presti projects 6–3.
